card_bake.description: Stages only: saved CardBake name, required when geometry is card_bake. Each stage bakes its currently grown source and visible guides.

end.description: Ending normalized growth progress, inclusive and greater than start.

fps.description: Alembic only: samples per second. Last sample time is (frames-1)/fps.

frames.description: Alembic only: uniformly sampled frames. Sample times are index/fps; changing topology is not interpolated by this exporter.

geometry.description: Stages only: regular generated geometry or foliage captured using a saved CardBake profile.

lod.description: base or a saved LOD name, applied before evaluating growth. Stage overrides may select another level.

max_output_mb.description: Maximum total package file bytes. Checked during export and before publication; failed exports preserve an existing completed package.

max_samples_mb.description: Cumulative uncompressed output mesh estimate, counting vertex and triangle records across samples. Not a process-memory limit.

output.description: Portable relative package directory. Contains manifest.json plus animation.abc and materials, or one GLB/CardBake package per stage.

source.description: Final mesh node for Alembic and regular geometry stages. CardBake stages use their selected bake profile's source, paths and keep.

stage_overrides.description: Stages only: zero-based step index to geometry/card_bake/lod overrides. Unspecified values inherit the profile.

steps.description: Stages only: independent snapshots over start..end. Separate from the legacy growth.steps batch.

type.description: Export a native Ogawa geometry cache or independent growth-stage GLBs. Profiles run only with --export NAME.
